summary: 10.0.35.04 Enterprise Release - Executive Reporting Parity: 100% server-driven favorites sync with Desktop, active refresh feedback, authentic SheetJS Excel (.xlsx) / RFC 4180 CSV / Executive PDF exports, Dynamic Viewer & Saved Reports catalog recovery, and company date & timestamp formatting.
highlights: 1. Report Center Server-Driven Favorites Parity (Tab 2): Aligned report ID constants to canonical server IDs (PROFITABILITY, GST_TAX, RETURNS_ANALYSIS, STOCK_SUMMARY, RECEIVABLE_AGEING, PAYABLE_AGEING, BANK_RECONCILIATION). Synchronized favorites unconditionally with /api/support/saved-views (screen: REPORT_FAVORITES) ensuring 1:1 parity between Desktop and Web.

2. Active Refresh Action Feedback: Added visual spinner animation, temporary button disabling during network query, audio synthesizer chime upon completion, and toast notification across all 4 reporting tabs.

3. Authentic Multi-Format Exports (Excel .xlsx, PDF, CSV): Replaced dummy CSV export with real Microsoft Excel (.xlsx) workbooks generated via SheetJS (xlsx.full.min.js), RFC 4180 compliant CSV with UTF-8 BOM, and formatted executive PDF reports with company letterhead, metadata, zebra styling, and totals.

4. Saved Reports Catalog & Dropdown Recovery (Tab 3): Resolved fatal TypeError bug (string.length() -> string.length) when parsing REPORT_V2 JSON, restoring populated saved report dropdown and catalog table.

5. Dynamic Viewer & Filter Parity: Aligned dynamic query payload with backend /api/reporting/run contract (from, to, documentStatus, sortKey, numeric minAmount/maxAmount). Restored semantic header icons, column formatting, and TableUiEnhancer styling on refresh.

6. Enterprise Date & Timestamp Formatting: Integrated FormatUtil company date/time configuration (company.dateFormat / company.timeFormat) across all reporting tables and Tab 4 Scheduled Reports KPI cards and delivery schedules.
